list.title: Exercise Reference Library
list.description: Prepare trusted movement references and see which exercise views are ready for member assessments.
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by exercise, muscle group, or equipment
list.emptyDescription: Add an exercise to start preparing trusted reference footage.

createSet.title: Create reference set
createSet.description: The current processor supports the SQUAT pattern. Camera view is detected from each source video.

createExercise.title: Add catalog exercise
createExercise.description: Choose the movement processor and keep each exercise variant separate.

sourceOutcomeDescription.ANALYZING: The system is analyzing this footage.
sourceOutcomeDescription.USABLE: Trusted footage is usable for the {{view}} reference.
sourceOutcomeDescription.USABLE_REDUCED: Usable for the {{view}} reference with reduced influence.
sourceOutcomeDescription.NEEDS_REVIEW: Review the evidence before this footage can contribute.
sourceOutcomeDescription.EXCLUDED: This footage does not contribute to a generated reference.
sourceOutcomeDescription.FAILED: Processing failed. Upload a replacement video.

workspace.footageDescription: Provide trusted GOOD movement examples. The camera view is detected automatically.
workspace.generatedDescription: Review the current candidate for each view. Older versions remain in history.
workspace.sourcesDescription: Processing state and review decisions are shown separately.
workspace.noSourcesDescription: Upload a GOOD MP4 reference video to generate the first profile.
workspace.profilesDescription: Profiles remain separated by detected view and retain their version history.
workspace.noProfilesDescription: A profile is generated synchronously after a compatible source is processed.
workspace.historyDescription: Older versions are retained for audit. Historical assessments keep their original linked version.

upload.title: Upload GOOD reference source
upload.description: Upload one MP4 at a time. Processing is synchronous and the detected camera view is assigned automatically.
upload.first: Upload the first GOOD reference video
upload.tooLarge: The video exceeds the 500 MB backend limit.
upload.uncertain: The connection ended before a result arrived. Processing may already have been saved. Refresh and inspect the footage list before submitting again.
upload.checkedHistory: I checked the saved footage; allow another upload

processing.title: Preparing reference footage
processing.description: Upload and analysis can take several minutes. This request does not expose individual stage progress. Keep this page open; saved processing records refresh automatically.

readiness.title: Analysis readiness
readiness.description: The system builds a separate reference for each supported camera angle so member videos are evaluated against a matching view.
readiness.empty: Readiness appears after the first supported camera view is detected.

publish.title: Publish
publish.description: Approve a generated version after review, then publish it separately for future Member assessments.
publish.pending: No version is live yet. Approve a candidate above before publishing it.

UPLOAD_SOURCE.title: Upload a GOOD reference video
UPLOAD_SOURCE.description: The pattern is fixed by this reference set. The backend detects the view automatically.

PROCESSING.title: Source processing is in progress
PROCESSING.description: Processing is synchronous. Keep this workspace open and inspect the result when the request completes.

INSPECT_FAILURE.title: Inspect the processing failure
INSPECT_FAILURE.description: Review the failure detail, then upload a replacement GOOD reference video.

REVIEW_SOURCES.title: Review source eligibility
REVIEW_SOURCES.description: Inspect decisions and evidence. Upload another source if no eligible aggregate profile was generated.

CONFIRM_PROFILE.title: Review and confirm the aggregate profile
CONFIRM_PROFILE.description: Check source decisions, profile quality and warnings before confirming the version.

ACTIVATE_PROFILE.title: Activate the confirmed profile
ACTIVATE_PROFILE.description: Activation makes this version the live reference for its detected view.

LIVE.title: Reference profile is live
LIVE.description: An active version is available while historical versions remain inspectable.

summary.groupedByView: Profiles are kept separate by view

sourceDescription.processing: The video is being processed before it can enter a reference group.
sourceDescription.failed: Processing failed. Inspect the diagnostic detail and upload a replacement video.
sourceDescription.accepted: Processed successfully and accepted into the {{view}} reference group.
sourceDescription.excluded: Processed successfully but excluded from reference aggregation.
sourceDescription.review: Needs evidence review because the decision is ambiguous.
sourceDescription.downWeight: Eligible for the {{view}} group with reduced aggregation weight.
sourceDescription.processed: Processed successfully. Review the evidence before continuing.

profileAction.confirmDescription: Confirm that the {{view}} aggregate profile has been reviewed. It will become eligible for activation.
profileAction.activateDescription: This makes v{{version}} the live {{view}} reference. Any currently active version for the same exercise and view becomes historical, not deleted.
profileAction.approveDescription: I reviewed the footage, analysis, and warnings and accept this generated {{view}} reference version v{{version}}.
profileAction.publishDescription: Version v{{version}} will be used for future matching Member assessments in the {{view}} view.
profileAction.replacementNotice: The previous live version becomes historical. Existing assessments keep their original linked version.

errors.invalid: The request or upload is invalid.
errors.forbidden: Your account cannot manage platform reference data.
errors.notFound: The exercise or reference set no longer exists.
errors.conflict: This lifecycle action is not allowed in the current state.
errors.generic: Movement reference data could not be loaded.

messages.exerciseCreated: Exercise added to the global catalog.
messages.sourceUploaded: Source processed and reference profiles refreshed.
messages.sourceUploadFailed: The source could not be processed. Inspect the failure and try another video.
messages.profileActivated: Reference published as live. Historical versions were preserved.

inspection.nextFailure: Review the saved failure. Check that the footage matches this exercise, selected movement and camera requirements.
inspection.stale: This upload has not reported a result for more than 10 minutes. Processing is synchronous and does not resume automatically after a server restart. Refresh saved results and ask support to check the request before submitting again.
inspection.excludedUpload: Video analyzed, but excluded from reference construction. Review the reason below.
inspection.pendingUpload: Video is saved; processing has not finished.
inspection.nextPublish: A reviewed version is approved. Inspect its details and publish it to make it available for future Member assessments.
inspection.nextReview: A new candidate is ready for review. Inspect source quality and repetitions before approving it. Approval and publication are separate steps.
inspection.nextProcessing: An upload is still processing. Refresh saved results to check its state; do not duplicate an uncertain submission.
inspection.nextLive: A published version is available to Members. Failed historical uploads do not replace it. Add footage only when preparing an updated version.
inspection.nextUpload: Choose a GOOD video of this exact exercise variant. Read the movement guidance, preview, upload, then inspect the saved result.
inspection.autoMetadata: Pattern and camera view are detected automatically. This aggregate-reference workflow cannot manually edit extracted metadata. Replace incorrectly classified footage; do not approve it to bypass a processing problem.
inspection.squatOnly: Processors: SQUAT, HINGE and vertical PULL (lat pulldown). PUSH awaits suitable validation footage. Only published matching references enable Member assessment.
inspection.setupDescription: Choose the matching movement and read its recording requirements. An empty workspace does not make this exercise assessable.
inspection.setupConfirm: I confirm that this exercise and its intended reference video match the selected movement and supported variant.
inspection.reusedExercise: Existing exercise selected. No duplicate exercise was created.
inspection.reuseHint: Search the catalog first. An existing name will be reused.
inspection.changeFilter: Clear the search or choose another reference filter.
inspection.noPhaseEvidence: Phase information is unavailable for this version.

VIDEO_NORMALIZATION_FAILED.title: Video could not be prepared
VIDEO_NORMALIZATION_FAILED.description: The server could not convert this recording for analysis. This does not establish that the original file is corrupt.
VIDEO_NORMALIZATION_FAILED.recovery: Try an H.264 MP4 export. If the same problem repeats, ask the operator to check video normalization.

PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE.title: Video processor needs attention
PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE.description: A required server tool, model, or runtime library is missing. This is a setup failure, not a judgment of the video or movement.
PROCESSOR_UNAVAILABLE.recovery: Ask the operator to repair the processor configuration. Re-uploading the same video will not fix a missing dependency.

UNSUPPORTED_PATTERN.title: Movement is not supported here
UNSUPPORTED_PATTERN.description: The detected movement does not match the selected reference processor or supported variant.
UNSUPPORTED_PATTERN.recovery: Select the correct exercise and SQUAT, HINGE or vertical PULL workspace. PUSH and horizontal pulls await validation.

UNSUPPORTED_VIEW.title: Camera angle is not supported
UNSUPPORTED_VIEW.description: This camera angle cannot be used for the selected movement reference.
UNSUPPORTED_VIEW.recovery: Use a side or oblique side recording with the hip, knee and ankle visible.

INSUFFICIENT_MOVEMENT_EVIDENCE.title: Not enough reliable repetitions
INSUFFICIENT_MOVEMENT_EVIDENCE.description: Not enough complete repetitions with reliable movement-specific landmarks could be extracted.
INSUFFICIENT_MOVEMENT_EVIDENCE.recovery: Record several complete repetitions in good light with the whole body visible. Do not approve an incomplete result.

VIDEO_DECODE_FAILED.title: Video could not be read
VIDEO_DECODE_FAILED.description: The file is corrupt or its video stream could not be decoded.
VIDEO_DECODE_FAILED.recovery: Choose an intact recording or export an H.264 MP4. Changing the filename alone does not convert the video.

PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.title: Processing took too long
PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.description: The request ended before processing completed within the allowed time.
PROCESSING_TIMEOUT.recovery: Refresh saved results first. If it failed, try a shorter recording or ask the operator to check the processor.

PROCESSING_CANCELLED.title: Processing was interrupted
PROCESSING_CANCELLED.description: The request ended before a usable result was completed.
PROCESSING_CANCELLED.recovery: Refresh and check the saved footage before choosing another video.

REFERENCE_PROCESSING_FAILED.title: Reference processing failed
REFERENCE_PROCESSING_FAILED.description: No usable result was completed for this upload. The exact failing stage is not established by the available evidence.
REFERENCE_PROCESSING_FAILED.recovery: Review the saved technical details with support. Keep the source record ID; replace the video only if the recording is the cause.

patternGuidance.SQUAT: Side or oblique-side view; show shoulders, hips, knees and ankles. Match the exact squat variant, equipment and complete repetitions.
patternGuidance.HINGE: Side or oblique-side view; show shoulders, hips, knees and ankles. Keep hip hinge and deficit deadlift references separate. Include several complete upright-to-upright cycles. Partial opening and closing lifts are excluded. Evidence comparison only; corrective feedback is not calibrated.
patternGuidance.PULL: Vertical lat pulldown only; side or oblique-side view with shoulders, elbows, wrists and hips visible, including the overhead position. Record several complete extended-arm-to-extended-arm cycles. Rows and other pulls are unvalidated. Evidence comparison only; corrective feedback is not calibrated.
